name: Fandom_Benchmark
description: Fandom_Benchmark is a dataset for evaluating language models on knowledge and question-answering tasks derived from fan communities and fandom wikis. It measures a model's ability to recall, reason about, and answer factual or semi-factual questions grounded in niche cultural domains. The benchmark focuses on diverse, often specialized trivia that tests breadth of world knowledge and domain-specific memory.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use for evaluating models on fandom-specific factual knowledge.
